fail_closed_release_blockers.condition: The actual product payload includes a closure-selected subset of native components from the locked 21-package Conda registry and native payload owned by CPython, the PyInstaller bootloader, and runtime distributions. The registry currently binds only Conda package metadata license names and provenance, while complete embedded-native closure and materials have not been mapped for known cases including CPython/libmpdec, the PyInstaller bootloader/zlib, NumPy/bundled native subcomponents, cffi/libffi, cryptography/OpenSSL/Rust, hnswlib/pybind11, jiter, pydantic-core, rpds-py, lxml/libxml2/libxslt, and PyYAML/LibYAML. Complete distributable license materials, audited SPDX expressions or reviewed LicenseRefs, and file-level provenance are therefore not yet bound for every shipped native component.
fail_closed_release_blockers.resolution: Audit every selector-matched native payload owner, including each included Conda package, CPython runtime component, PyInstaller bootloader, and native runtime distribution; bind the relevant upstream SBOM files and reachable subcomponent set by hash; freeze applicable license and notice materials with immutable provenance; and record a valid SPDX expression or an explicit reviewed LicenseRef for every actual payload component.
